prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: original Silent Storm painted clothing/body diffuse UV atlas ID6824.
Image1 is the ONLY original edit target: full original128x128 RGBA enlarged nearest8x1024x1024, without any crop. Produce this SAME whole square UV atlas with finer painted transitions/detail for four-times source resolution. Preserve the original field contours, boundaries, source shading phase, source-relative local palette and physical pattern scale. Output only this texture map, no body, person or scene.
Original materials: muted gray-brown clothing in the entire right large field, darkgray vertical middle strip, bluegray lowerleft cloth, dark red-brown left painted color fields and their existing broad horizontal shading. Keep those materials and their dim hierarchy. Refine only existing fine painted mottling/soft gradients; do not replace them with photographic weave, leather pores, shiny plastic, coarse grain, new folds or raised edges.
Preserve the THREE existing small cool pale diagonal painted groups at native bounds[0,71,2,72],[3,72,11,77],[11,78,14,81]. They are faint segmented washed color traces, with existing weak joining pixels already present; preserve their actual source contours/gaps and fade, NOT new stitches, chain links, rings, letters or garment hardware. Do not invent more marks, sharpen them into a chain, close their faint gaps or brighten them substantially.
The right flap has ONE small pale existing paint group. Keep that one small irregular source shape at original native phase near[105,65], and keep the existing dark horizontal flap field native[103,62,128,69] just as subdued. No new flap border, button, metal rim, hole, pocket stitching or duplicate mark.
Rightgraycloth field native[65,0,128,127], middle strip[39,0,65,102], lowerleftbluegraycloth[17,78,37,128], leftbrownwash[0,0,39,73] stay in their exact wholecanvas UV position. Preserve all native top/bottom/side field endpoints and original ambiguous small dark/brown washes. No interpretive anatomy, nails, hands, face or new garment pieces.
Source alpha255 over the ENTIRE canvas, including opaque black separators/corners: black RGB is NOT a transparent hole. Keep the wholecanvas opaque. No crop, padding, letterbox, recentering, registration, new margin, text, labels, logos or watermark. Preserve the soft old-game painted appearance; fine HD refinement improves existing paint, not number/geometry/prominence of details.
reference_recipe: Exact original128x128 wholeRGBA nearest8x1024x1024; no crop/padding/BBox/artistic edit; inverse wholeLanczos512x512, numeric gain and complete original A only.

review_requirements: Inspect decoded original before imagegen; resolve UV and atlas layout.
Preserve original logical size, alpha, material, repeat/detail scale and character identity.
Do not infer acceptance from historical/release equality; inspect normalized generation privately.
source_record.source_match: Exact decoded RGBA and dimensions match release
